title: Mlai mid scenario pii training data
topic: Mlai mid scenario pii training data
question: How would you handle the personal data in this pipeline, both to build a good model and to do it responsibly?
idealAnswer:
Identify and strip or mask direct identifiers, names, emails, phone numbers, that aren't predictive signal themselves and only create privacy risk and potential for the model to memorize them

Free-text transcripts need scrubbing or anonymization, e.g. redacting names and addresses, before being used for features or embeddings, since raw text can leak PII directly into feature representations or model outputs

Apply the principle of least access, only pipeline components that truly need raw PII should have access to it, with logging and access controls in place

Consider whether some fields, e.g. exact phone number, should be excluded entirely as legally or ethically inappropriate to use for a churn decision, versus derived non-identifying features, e.g. tenure length, that are fine

Mentions relevant data handling practices like encryption at rest, retention limits, and compliance requirements, e.g. GDPR or CCPA, that govern how long and in what form this data can be stored
